source_of_truth: coverage_gate.check_structural_coverage writes one TrangThaiNghiaVu row per obligation at the branch that decides it; the same call that produces missing/chan_doan
decision_unchanged: ok, error_code, missing, chan_doan, weak_kinds, symbol_reconciled, ten_da_hoa_giai and every route outcome are byte-identical to START_HEAD on all parity fixtures
emitted_when: route stops at structural_coverage with requested_operation_uncovered; SemanticRouteOutcome.coverage_diagnostic is null on every other outcome and the semantic_route event carries the key only when non-null

diagnostic_header_fields.route_code: ErrorCode value of the coverage rejection
diagnostic_header_fields.requested_count: number of obligations in the RequestContract

row_fields_trace.obligation_pointer: RFC 6901 pointer into RequestContract.model_dump(mode=json), or null
row_fields_trace.operation_kind: original obligation kind if inside OBLIGATION_KINDS, else null
row_fields_trace.canonical_operation_kind: kind after nghia_vu_chinh_tac, or null when not evaluated
row_fields_trace.target_kind: MemoryType of the resolved container, or null when the program has none
row_fields_trace.reason_code: one stable code per rule branch (see reason_codes)
row_fields_trace.evidence_kind: kind of evidence the deciding branch inspected, or null
row_fields_trace.evidence_count: number of evidence items found for evidence_kind (non-negative integer)

row_fields_source_only.obligation_fingerprint: first 16 hex of SHA-256 over canonical JSON of the obligation; used only to verify pointers; never written to the trace

reason_codes.branch: binding resolves to several program objects
container absent from program symbol table
container type not accepted and no relational witness resolution
structural operand named but never constructed
witness absent from program symbol table
witness declared but no statement produces it
relational kind with empty witness dependency closure
quantity witness not derived from container and resolution not OK with >1 operand
structure proven and a server-owned checker exists

evidence_kinds.count: solid/plane operands present (missing branch) or constructed (other branches)
objects in the witness dependency closure
objects in the witness dependency closure (relational kinds)

pointer_policy.source: pointer built from the loop index over contract.obligations and self-verified: the element at the pointer in contract.model_dump(mode=json) must carry the row fingerprint, else pointer=null and AMBIGUOUS
pointer_policy.field_name_assumption: none trusted blindly — the field token must resolve to the same obligation
pointer_policy.runner: re-verified against the RequestContract rebuilt from the analyze response; fingerprint mismatch, unresolvable pointer or malformed pointer => pointer=null, AMBIGUOUS; without a contract the source status is kept but the pointer must match /<field>/<index>
pointer_policy.duplicate_obligations: pointer stays EXACT because the source index is known, not inferred

never_stored: labels or object names from the problem or program
vocabulary_enforcement_in_runner: values outside the closed vocabularies are replaced by OUT_OF_VOCABULARY; counts must be non-negative integers else null; route_stage/route_code must match [a-z_]{1,64}
